restaking_cluster_context.yield_source: ETH staking yield + EigenLayer AVS restaking fees
restaking_cluster_context.unique_property: Protocol earns additional yield from EigenLayer security provision
restaking_cluster_context.mechanism: Liquid restaking: stake ETH → eETH → restake on EigenLayer → earn ETH+AVS rewards
restaking_cluster_context.vs_ldo_distinction: LDO = liquid staking only (stETH fee). ETHFI = liquid staking PLUS EigenLayer restaking (extra AVS layer). LDO REJECT K594 = pure gov token. ETHFI hypothesis = additional restaking yield creates distinct FR dynamics.
restaking_cluster_context.vs_ena_distinction: ENA = synthetic stable (perp FR arb, delta-neutral). ETHFI = liquid restaking (spot ETH + restaking, ETH-long). Different yield mechanism: ENA uses perp markets, ETHFI uses consensus layer.
restaking_cluster_context.avs_exposure: ETHFI exposed to EigenLayer AVS ecosystem growth: Eigen DA, Omni Network, EigenDA, etc.
restaking_cluster_context.slashing_risk: EigenLayer slashing risk on restaked ETH → ETHFI FR spikes during slashing events
restaking_cluster_context.distinct_from_defi_gov: ETHFI is not DeFi governance (DEX/lending). ETHFI is liquid restaking infrastructure equity.

adf_stationarity.interpretation: ETHFI-BTC FR differential IS stationary at 1% level (statistic -19.7593 vs 1% critical -3.4305). Mean-reversion assumption CONFIRMED.

ornstein_uhlenbeck.interpretation: Half-life 3.67h (0.153d). Fast mean-reversion. 7d rolling window filters noise for persistent FR divergence. ETHFI restaking yield shocks (AVS launches/slashing) create FR spikes with gradual mean-reversion.

autocorrelation.interpretation: ACF(1h)=0.8114, ACF(24h)=0.2886, ACF(168h)=0.1254. Positive ACF at 24h/168h confirms FR differential persists at weekly scale — supports rolling-mean signal construction.

ethfi_characteristics.eigenlayer_mechanics: ETHFI (Ether.fi) specific mechanics: 1. eETH/weETH = liquid restaking token: deposit ETH → Ether.fi → restake on EigenLayer → earn ETH+AVS rewards. 2. ETHFI governance: captures Ether.fi protocol fee revenue (% of restaking yield). 3. AVS exposure: EigenLayer Active Validator Sets pay restakers (EigenDA, Omni Network, etc.). 4. ETHFI demand ∝ eETH/weETH APY (ETH staking + AVS rewards). 5. Slashing risk: EigenLayer operator slashing → ETHFI FR spikes. 6. vs LDO (K594 REJECT): LDO = basic stETH staking only. ETHFI = ETH staking + EigenLayer AVS layer. 7. vs ENA (K616 ACCEPT): ENA = delta-neutral synthetic stable (FR arb). ETHFI = spot ETH-long restaking. 8. EigenLayer growth cycles: AVS launches drive ETHFI demand cycles (distinct from BTC speculative cycles). 9. Multi-venue: HL, Bybit, OKX all list ETHFI (major restaking token). 10. Cluster: Restaking Yield (new cluster, peers: EIGEN if listed, RPL rocketpool).
